# prism_customer_managed_policy (Resource)

Manages a CloudKeeper customer-managed policy (an IAM policy in the CMP library that can be attached to permission sets).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "prism_customer_managed_policy" "s3_read" {
  name        = "S3ReadOnly"
  description = "List and read S3 buckets"
  policy_document = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect   = "Allow"
      Action   = ["s3:Get*", "s3:List*"]
      Resource = "*"
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The policy name (unique within the tenant).
- `policy_document` (String) The IAM policy document as a JSON string. Keep it canonical — formatting-only differences show as a diff.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the customer-managed policy.
